current.service_desc:
Haivision Hub for Government (HUB-GOV) is an easy-to-use video network service for securely and reliably transporting live streaming video from agency networks to other inter- and intra-agency destinations or for connecting live streams between agency networks and commercial cloud destinations. Hub Gov accomplishes this routing while adding minimal latency and providing AES-256 encryption of live streams.

Offering start-up, integrated device control, stream optimization, and status & monitoring, all from a single browser window, Haivision Hub is ideal for any government organization needing an on-demand low latency video contribution network for any public affairs, citizen-facing communications, or cross-agency collaboration with live video.
